summary: The paper presents a FeFET-based compute-in-memory FPGA architecture for neural network inference. An exhaustive search of the paper text, GitHub (repo search, code search, author profile repos), and web search found no code repository or code availability statement associated with this paper. The authors did not release their design (which uses Cadence Virtuoso for layout and VTR for FPGA evaluation) as open-source code. No HLS designs were found either.
